            self.slow_prev = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        is_crossover = (self.fast_prev is not None and self.slow_prev is not None) and \

                self.entry_price = 0.0
                self.entry_order_ticket = None

                    bid = qb.Bid.Close

        # 5-Minute TradeBar Consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries (09:30-09:35 ends at 09:35)
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))

        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # Portfolio & Order State Tracking
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.exit_order_id = None
        self.pending_entry = False
        self.no_entry_until_date = None

        # Scheduled Time Stop at 15:45 NY Time daily
        self.Schedule.On(
            self.DateRules.EveryDay(self.spy),
            self.TimeRules.At(15, 45),
            self.CheckTimeStop
        )

        Consolidator handler for 5-minute SPY bars.
        Updates moving averages and evaluates entry signals.
        """
        # Update indicators with the 5-minute bar closing price
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        # Both averages must be ready before testing signal
        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            if self.fast_sma.IsReady:
                self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            if self.slow_sma.IsReady:
                self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Bullish crossover: prev_fast <= prev_slow and curr_fast > curr_slow
        is_crossover = False

            is_crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (curr_fast > curr_slow)

        # Update previous values for next bar evaluation
        self.prev_fast = curr_fast
        self.prev_slow = curr_slow

        if not is_crossover:
            return

        # Check entry window: crossover bar ends from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Do not enter if forced liquidation occurred today
        if self.no_entry_until_date and self.Time.date() <= self.no_entry_until_date:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - Forced liquidation occurred today.")
            return

        # Do not enter if holding an option position or an entry order is open
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None or self.pending_entry or self.Portfolio.Invested:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - Active position or open order exists.")
            return

        slice_data = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice_data is None or not slice_data.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - No option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        if not chain or len(chain) == 0:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - Option chain is empty.")
            return

        # Get SPY underlying price
        if not self.Securities.ContainsKey(self.spy) or not self.Securities[self.spy].HasData:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - SPY price unavailable.")

        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - SPY price non-positive.")
            return

        current_date = self.Time.date()
        min_expiry_date = current_date + timedelta(days=7)

        # Select target expiration: nearest expiration date >= current_date + 7 calendar days
        valid_expiries = {c.Expiry.date() for c in chain if c.Expiry.date() >= min_expiry_date}
        if not valid_expiries:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - No expiration >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        min_strike = 1.01 * spy_price
        matching_contracts = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.Expiry.date() == target_expiry
            and c.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and c.Strike >= min_strike
        ]

            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped - No qualifying Call contract >= 101% OTM for expiry {target_expiry}.")
            return

        # Sort by lowest strike, tie-break by ascending string value of contract Symbol
        matching_contracts.sort(key=lambda c: (c.Strike, str(c.Symbol)))
        selected_contract = matching_contracts[0]

        # Add subscription to ensure minute data stream for the selected option
        self.AddOptionContract(selected_contract.Symbol, Resolution.Minute)

        # Execute market order for 1 contract
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        if ticket.Status != OrderStatus.Invalid:
            self.pending_entry = True
            self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: ENTRY ORDER SUBMITTED | Symbol: {selected_contract.Symbol.Value} | Strike: {selected_contract.Strike} | Expiry: {target_expiry} | SPY Price: {spy_price:.2f}")
        else:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: ENTRY ORDER FAILED | Invalid order for {selected_contract.Symbol.Value}.")

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice):
        """
        Evaluated on each minute slice for exits and unintended equity positions.
        """
        # 1. Liquidate immediately if exercise or assignment created a SPY equity position
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: EXERCISE/ASSIGNMENT DETECTED | Liquidated SPY equity position immediately.")

        if self.held_contract_symbol is None or self.entry_fill_price is None:
            return

        if not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested:
            return

        expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
        if self.Time.date() >= expiry_date:
            if self.exit_order_id is None:
                self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: EXPIRATION SAFETY EXIT | Liquidating held contract {self.held_contract_symbol.Value} on expiration day.")
                self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(self.held_contract_symbol)
                ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity)
                self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
                self.no_entry_until_date = self.Time.date()
            return

        if self.exit_order_id is not None:
            return

        bid, ask, has_quote = self.GetOptionBidAsk(slice, self.held_contract_symbol)

        if has_quote and bid > 0 and ask > 0:
            mid = (bid + ask) / 2.0
            profit_target = 1.50 * self.entry_fill_price
            if mid >= profit_target:
                self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: PROFIT TARGET HIT | Mid: {mid:.2f} >= Target: {profit_target:.2f} (Entry: {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}). Liquidating.")
                self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(self.held_contract_symbol)
                ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity)
                self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
